---- MODULE StatueDelivery ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS TaskLimit, MountLimit, FailureLimit, Names, ClearRule, DeliveryRule
VARIABLES mount, phase, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
    dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error, ended

vars == <<mount, phase, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
    dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error, ended>>

\* IDs are allocated in sidecar creation order; 0 means no adopted ID.
\* "running" abstracts queued/running; "expired" is succeeded, age >= 600s.
\* Names abstract sourceName with its extension stripped and "-statue.stl"
\* appended. Recovery has exactly the filename used by the unchanged hook.
\* Error tokens are distinct injected messages, observed at onError after
\* catch/finally settles. Poll and callback awaits are separate driver steps.
\* Call history and cleared are observer history, not proposed hook storage.
\* Callbacks have stable identities within a mount. Reload destroys the old
\* page's continuations, preserves the sidecar and storage, and mounts anew.
\* A pending call remains in history on reload: invocation already happened.
\* An unanswered rule imposes only the common minimum of its two options.
\* Next describes safe prefixes of the existing hook; it neither renames files
\* nor adds persistence or cancellation. The two excluded bug actions expose
\* its known violating delivery steps to the conformance check.

Tasks == 1..TaskLimit
Causes == {"start", "task", "download", "delivery", "poll"}
Busy == {"starting", "polling", "download", "ready", "delivering"}
Phases == Busy \cup {"idle", "done", "error"}
Latest == Len(remote)
RemoteStatus(t) == IF t \in 1..Len(remote) THEN remote[t] ELSE "absent"
Recoverable == RemoteStatus(Latest) \in {"running", "succeeded"}
ServiceFree == RemoteStatus(Latest) # "running"
CallType == [task : Tasks, name : Names, atMount : 1..MountLimit,
    source : {"fresh", "recovery"},
    result : {"pending", "ok", "rejected"}, afterClear : BOOLEAN]

Counted(cs) ==
    {i \in 1..Len(cs) : DeliveryRule = "invocation" \/ cs[i].result = "ok"}

Once(cs) ==
    \A i, j \in Counted(cs) : cs[i].task = cs[j].task => i = j

DistinctNames(cs) ==
    \A i, j \in Counted(cs) :
        cs[i].task # cs[j].task => cs[i].name # cs[j].name

ClearCallsOK(cs) ==
    ClearRule # "stop" \/ \A i \in 1..Len(cs) : ~cs[i].afterClear

NewCall ==
    Append(calls, [task |-> last, name |-> name, atMount |-> mount,
        source |-> origin,
        result |-> "pending", afterClear |-> last \in cleared])

SuccessfulCall ==
    IF Len(calls) = 0 THEN calls
    ELSE [calls EXCEPT ![Len(calls)].result = "ok"]
RejectedCall ==
    IF Len(calls) = 0 THEN calls
    ELSE [calls EXCEPT ![Len(calls)].result = "rejected"]

AtMostOnce ==
    /\ Once(calls)
    /\ ClearCallsOK(calls)
    /\ origin = "recovery" => last # recoveryDismissed

NamesNeverReplace == DistinctNames(calls)

OneInFlight ==
    /\ Cardinality(active) <= 1
    /\ guard = (active # {})
    /\ guard = (phase \in Busy)
    /\ phase = "starting" => active = {0}
    /\ phase \in Busy \ {"starting"} => active = {last}

FailureExit ==
    /\ phase = "error" =>
        (ended \in Causes /\ error = ended /\ ~guard /\ active = {})
    /\ ended \in Causes /\ phase # "starting" => phase = "error"
    /\ phase = "polling" => streak < FailureLimit
    /\ phase = "error" /\ ended = "poll" => streak = FailureLimit

TypeOK ==
    /\ mount \in 1..MountLimit
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ remote \in Seq({"running", "succeeded", "expired", "failed"})
    /\ Len(remote) <= TaskLimit
    /\ active \subseteq 0..TaskLimit
    /\ guard \in BOOLEAN
    /\ last \in 0..Len(remote)
    /\ name \in Names \cup {""}
    /\ origin \in {"none", "fresh", "recovery"}
    /\ streak \in 0..FailureLimit
    /\ dismissed \in 0..Len(remote)
    /\ cleared \subseteq Tasks
    /\ calls \in Seq(CallType)
    /\ Len(calls) <= TaskLimit + MountLimit
    /\ recoveryPending \in BOOLEAN
    /\ recoveryDismissed \in 0..TaskLimit
    /\ error \in Causes \cup {"none"}
    /\ ended \in Causes \cup {"none", "success"}

FreshDelivery == phase = "done" /\ origin = "fresh"
ReloadDelivery == phase = "done" /\ origin = "recovery" /\ mount = 2
RestartAfterTaskFailure == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "task"
RestartAfterDownloadFailure == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "download"
RestartAfterDeliveryFailure == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "delivery"
RestartAfterFivePollFailures == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "poll"
ClearedWorkDelivered ==
    \E i \in 1..Len(calls) : calls[i].afterClear /\ calls[i].result = "ok"
ClearBlocksRecovery ==
    mount = 2 /\ dismissed # 0 /\ phase = "idle" /\ ~recoveryPending
RejectedThenDelivered ==
    /\ mount = 2
    /\ \E i, j \in 1..Len(calls) :
        i < j /\ calls[i].task = calls[j].task
        /\ calls[i].result = "rejected" /\ calls[j].result = "ok"

Init ==
    /\ mount = 1
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ remote = <<>>
    /\ active = {}
    /\ guard = FALSE
    /\ last = 0
    /\ name = ""
    /\ origin = "none"
    /\ streak = 0
    /\ dismissed = 0
    /\ cleared = {}
    /\ calls = <<>>
    /\ recoveryPending = TRUE
    /\ recoveryDismissed = 0
    /\ error = "none"
    /\ ended = "none"

\* An independently created sidecar task can be observed by mount recovery.
SidecarTask ==
    /\ Latest < TaskLimit /\ ServiceFree
    /\ remote' = Append(remote, "running")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

SidecarFinish ==
    /\ \E t \in 1..Latest, s \in {"succeeded", "failed"} :
        remote[t] = "running" /\ remote' = [remote EXCEPT ![t] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

AgeOut ==
    /\ \E t \in 1..Latest :
        remote[t] = "succeeded" /\ remote' = [remote EXCEPT ![t] = "expired"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

Start ==
    /\ ~guard /\ Latest < TaskLimit
    /\ phase' = "starting"
    /\ active' = {0}
    /\ guard' = TRUE
    /\ name' \in Names
    /\ origin' = "fresh"
    /\ streak' = 0
    /\ error' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, dismissed, cleared, calls,
        recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, ended>>

RefuseStart ==
    /\ guard
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Create ==
    /\ phase = "starting" /\ Latest < TaskLimit /\ ServiceFree
    /\ remote' = Append(remote, "running")
    /\ last' = Latest + 1
    /\ active' = {Latest + 1}
    /\ phase' = "polling"
    /\ ended' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, guard, name, origin, streak, dismissed, cleared,
        calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error>>

\* Health, engine-readiness and create failures share start's catch/finally.
StartFailure ==
    /\ phase = "starting"
    /\ phase' = "error" /\ error' = "start" /\ ended' = "start"
    /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, streak, dismissed,
        cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed>>

Recover ==
    /\ recoveryPending /\ ~guard /\ Recoverable /\ Latest # dismissed
    /\ recoveryPending' = FALSE
    /\ recoveryDismissed' = dismissed
    /\ last' = Latest
    /\ phase' = "polling" /\ active' = {Latest} /\ guard' = TRUE
    /\ name' = "recovered-statue.stl" /\ origin' = "recovery"
    /\ streak' = 0 /\ ended' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, dismissed, cleared, calls, error>>

SkipRecovery ==
    /\ recoveryPending
    /\ guard \/ ~Recoverable \/ Latest = dismissed
    /\ recoveryPending' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin,
        streak, dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryDismissed, error, ended>>

PollRunning ==
    /\ phase = "polling" /\ RemoteStatus(last) = "running"
    /\ streak' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

PollSucceeded ==
    /\ phase = "polling" /\ RemoteStatus(last) \in {"succeeded", "expired"}
    /\ streak' = 0 /\ phase' = "download"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

PollTaskFailed ==
    /\ phase = "polling" /\ RemoteStatus(last) = "failed"
    /\ streak' = 0 /\ phase' = "error"
    /\ error' = "task" /\ ended' = "task" /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, dismissed, cleared,
        calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed>>

PollException ==
    /\ phase = "polling"
    /\ streak' = streak + 1
    /\ IF streak' = FailureLimit
        THEN /\ phase' = "error" /\ error' = "poll" /\ ended' = "poll"
             /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {}
        ELSE UNCHANGED <<phase, error, ended, guard, active>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, dismissed, cleared,
        calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed>>

DownloadOK ==
    /\ phase = "download" /\ phase' = "ready"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

DownloadFailed ==
    /\ phase = "download" /\ phase' = "error"
    /\ error' = "download" /\ ended' = "download"
    /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, streak, dismissed,
        cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed>>

InvokeDelivery ==
    /\ phase = "ready"
    /\ Once(NewCall) /\ DistinctNames(NewCall) /\ ClearCallsOK(NewCall)
    /\ phase' = "delivering" /\ calls' = NewCall
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
        dismissed, cleared, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error, ended>>

DeliveryOK ==
    /\ phase = "delivering"
    /\ Once(SuccessfulCall) /\ DistinctNames(SuccessfulCall)
    /\ phase' = "done" /\ calls' = SuccessfulCall
    /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {} /\ ended' = "success"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, streak, dismissed,
        cleared, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error>>

DeliveryFailed ==
    /\ phase = "delivering" /\ phase' = "error" /\ calls' = RejectedCall
    /\ error' = "delivery" /\ ended' = "delivery"
    /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, streak, dismissed,
        cleared, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed>>

Clear ==
    /\ last # 0
    /\ dismissed' = last /\ cleared' = cleared \cup {last}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin,
        streak, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error, ended>>

Reload ==
    /\ mount < MountLimit /\ mount' = mount + 1
    /\ phase' = "idle" /\ active' = {} /\ guard' = FALSE /\ last' = 0
    /\ name' = "" /\ origin' = "none" /\ streak' = 0
    /\ recoveryPending' = TRUE /\ recoveryDismissed' = 0
    /\ error' = "none" /\ ended' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<remote, dismissed, cleared, calls>>

\* A timer, network call or callback may remain unresolved; no outside-world
\* fairness is assumed. Terminal states may also wait for a user action.
Wait == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ SidecarTask \/ SidecarFinish \/ AgeOut
    \/ Start \/ RefuseStart \/ Create \/ StartFailure
    \/ Recover \/ SkipRecovery
    \/ PollRunning \/ PollSucceeded \/ PollTaskFailed \/ PollException
    \/ DownloadOK \/ DownloadFailed
    \/ InvokeDelivery \/ DeliveryOK \/ DeliveryFailed
    \/ Clear \/ Reload \/ Wait

\* Current-code defect: recovery can send an already delivered task again.
BugRedeliver ==
    \/ /\ phase = "ready"
       /\ origin = "recovery"
       /\ \E i \in Counted(calls) :
           calls[i].task = last /\ calls[i].atMount < mount
       /\ ~Once(NewCall) /\ DistinctNames(NewCall) /\ ClearCallsOK(NewCall)
       /\ phase' = "delivering" /\ calls' = NewCall
       /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
           dismissed, cleared, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error, ended>>
    \/ /\ phase = "delivering"
       /\ origin = "recovery"
       /\ \E i \in Counted(calls) :
           calls[i].task = last /\ calls[i].atMount < mount
       /\ ~Once(SuccessfulCall) /\ DistinctNames(SuccessfulCall)
       /\ phase' = "done" /\ calls' = SuccessfulCall
       /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {} /\ ended' = "success"
       /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, streak, dismissed,
           cleared, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error>>

\* Current-code defect: different recovered tasks use recovered-statue.stl;
\* fresh tasks with equal source basenames can collide in the same way.
BugReplaceName ==
    \/ /\ phase = "ready"
       /\ origin = "recovery"
       /\ \E i \in Counted(calls) :
           calls[i].task # last /\ calls[i].source = "recovery"
       /\ Once(NewCall) /\ ~DistinctNames(NewCall) /\ ClearCallsOK(NewCall)
       /\ phase' = "delivering" /\ calls' = NewCall
       /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
           dismissed, cleared, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error, ended>>
    \/ /\ phase = "delivering"
       /\ origin = "recovery"
       /\ \E i \in Counted(calls) :
           calls[i].task # last /\ calls[i].source = "recovery"
       /\ Once(SuccessfulCall) /\ ~DistinctNames(SuccessfulCall)
       /\ phase' = "done" /\ calls' = SuccessfulCall
       /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {} /\ ended' = "success"
       /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, streak, dismissed,
           cleared, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error>>

vars == <<mount, phase, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
    dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error, ended>>

\* IDs are allocated in sidecar creation order; 0 means no adopted ID.
\* "running" abstracts queued/running; "expired" is succeeded, age >= 600s.
\* Names abstract sourceName with its extension stripped and "-statue.stl"
\* appended. Recovery has exactly the filename used by the unchanged hook.
\* Error tokens are distinct injected messages, observed at onError after
\* catch/finally settles. Poll and callback awaits are separate driver steps.
\* Call history and cleared are observer history, not proposed hook storage.
\* Callbacks have stable identities within a mount. Reload destroys the old
\* page's continuations, preserves the sidecar and storage, and mounts anew.
\* A pending call remains in history on reload: invocation already happened.
\* An unanswered rule imposes only the common minimum of its two options.
\* Next describes safe prefixes of the existing hook; it neither renames files
\* nor adds persistence or cancellation. The two excluded bug actions expose
\* its known violating delivery steps to the conformance check.

Tasks == 1..TaskLimit
Causes == {"start", "task", "download", "delivery", "poll"}
Busy == {"starting", "polling", "download", "ready", "delivering"}
Phases == Busy \cup {"idle", "done", "error"}
Latest == Len(remote)
RemoteStatus(t) == IF t \in 1..Len(remote) THEN remote[t] ELSE "absent"
Recoverable == RemoteStatus(Latest) \in {"running", "succeeded"}
ServiceFree == RemoteStatus(Latest) # "running"
CallType == [task : Tasks, name : Names, atMount : 1..MountLimit,
    source : {"fresh", "recovery"},
    result : {"pending", "ok", "rejected"}, afterClear : BOOLEAN]

Counted(cs) ==
    {i \in 1..Len(cs) : DeliveryRule = "invocation" \/ cs[i].result = "ok"}

Once(cs) ==
    \A i, j \in Counted(cs) : cs[i].task = cs[j].task => i = j

DistinctNames(cs) ==
    \A i, j \in Counted(cs) :
        cs[i].task # cs[j].task => cs[i].name # cs[j].name

ClearCallsOK(cs) ==
    ClearRule # "stop" \/ \A i \in 1..Len(cs) : ~cs[i].afterClear

NewCall ==
    Append(calls, [task |-> last, name |-> name, atMount |-> mount,
        source |-> origin,
        result |-> "pending", afterClear |-> last \in cleared])

SuccessfulCall ==
    IF Len(calls) = 0 THEN calls
    ELSE [calls EXCEPT ![Len(calls)].result = "ok"]
RejectedCall ==
    IF Len(calls) = 0 THEN calls
    ELSE [calls EXCEPT ![Len(calls)].result = "rejected"]

AtMostOnce ==
    /\ Once(calls)
    /\ ClearCallsOK(calls)
    /\ origin = "recovery" => last # recoveryDismissed

NamesNeverReplace == DistinctNames(calls)

OneInFlight ==
    /\ Cardinality(active) <= 1
    /\ guard = (active # {})
    /\ guard = (phase \in Busy)
    /\ phase = "starting" => active = {0}
    /\ phase \in Busy \ {"starting"} => active = {last}

FailureExit ==
    /\ phase = "error" =>
        (ended \in Causes /\ error = ended /\ ~guard /\ active = {})
    /\ ended \in Causes /\ phase # "starting" => phase = "error"
    /\ phase = "polling" => streak < FailureLimit
    /\ phase = "error" /\ ended = "poll" => streak = FailureLimit

    /\ mount \in 1..MountLimit
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ remote \in Seq({"running", "succeeded", "expired", "failed"})
    /\ Len(remote) <= TaskLimit
    /\ active \subseteq 0..TaskLimit
    /\ guard \in BOOLEAN
    /\ last \in 0..Len(remote)
    /\ name \in Names \cup {""}
    /\ origin \in {"none", "fresh", "recovery"}
    /\ streak \in 0..FailureLimit
    /\ dismissed \in 0..Len(remote)
    /\ cleared \subseteq Tasks
    /\ calls \in Seq(CallType)
    /\ Len(calls) <= TaskLimit + MountLimit
    /\ recoveryPending \in BOOLEAN
    /\ recoveryDismissed \in 0..TaskLimit
    /\ error \in Causes \cup {"none"}
    /\ ended \in Causes \cup {"none", "success"}

FreshDelivery == phase = "done" /\ origin = "fresh"
ReloadDelivery == phase = "done" /\ origin = "recovery" /\ mount = 2
RestartAfterTaskFailure == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "task"
RestartAfterDownloadFailure == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "download"
RestartAfterDeliveryFailure == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "delivery"
RestartAfterFivePollFailures == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "poll"
ClearedWorkDelivered ==
    \E i \in 1..Len(calls) : calls[i].afterClear /\ calls[i].result = "ok"

    mount = 2 /\ dismissed # 0 /\ phase = "idle" /\ ~recoveryPending

---- MODULE StatueDelivery ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS TaskLimit, MountLimit, FailureLimit, Names, ClearRule, DeliveryRule
VARIABLES mount, phase, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
    dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error, ended

vars == <<mount, phase, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
    dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error, ended>>

\* IDs are allocated in sidecar creation order; 0 means no adopted ID.
\* "running" abstracts queued/running; "expired" is succeeded, age >= 600s.
\* Names abstract sourceName with its extension stripped and "-statue.stl"
\* appended. Recovery has exactly the filename used by the unchanged hook.
\* Error tokens are distinct injected messages, observed at onError after
\* catch/finally settles. Poll and callback awaits are separate driver steps.
\* Call history and cleared are observer history, not proposed hook storage.
\* Callbacks have stable identities within a mount. Reload destroys the old
\* page's continuations, preserves the sidecar and storage, and mounts anew.
\* A pending call remains in history on reload: invocation already happened.
\* An unanswered rule imposes only the common minimum of its two options.
\* Next describes safe prefixes of the existing hook; it neither renames files
\* nor adds persistence or cancellation. The two excluded bug actions expose
\* its known violating delivery steps to the conformance check.

Tasks == 1..TaskLimit
Causes == {"start", "task", "download", "delivery", "poll"}
Busy == {"starting", "polling", "download", "ready", "delivering"}
Phases == Busy \cup {"idle", "done", "error"}
Latest == Len(remote)
RemoteStatus(t) == IF t \in 1..Len(remote) THEN remote[t] ELSE "absent"
Recoverable == RemoteStatus(Latest) \in {"running", "succeeded"}
ServiceFree == RemoteStatus(Latest) # "running"
CallType == [task : Tasks, name : Names, atMount : 1..MountLimit,
    source : {"fresh", "recovery"},
    result : {"pending", "ok", "rejected"}, afterClear : BOOLEAN]

Counted(cs) ==
    {i \in 1..Len(cs) : DeliveryRule = "invocation" \/ cs[i].result = "ok"}

Once(cs) ==
    \A i, j \in Counted(cs) : cs[i].task = cs[j].task => i = j

DistinctNames(cs) ==
    \A i, j \in Counted(cs) :
        cs[i].task # cs[j].task => cs[i].name # cs[j].name

ClearCallsOK(cs) ==
    ClearRule # "stop" \/ \A i \in 1..Len(cs) : ~cs[i].afterClear

NewCall ==
    Append(calls, [task |-> last, name |-> name, atMount |-> mount,
        source |-> origin,
        result |-> "pending", afterClear |-> last \in cleared])

SuccessfulCall ==
    IF Len(calls) = 0 THEN calls
    ELSE [calls EXCEPT ![Len(calls)].result = "ok"]
RejectedCall ==
    IF Len(calls) = 0 THEN calls
    ELSE [calls EXCEPT ![Len(calls)].result = "rejected"]

AtMostOnce ==
    /\ Once(calls)
    /\ ClearCallsOK(calls)
    /\ origin = "recovery" => last # recoveryDismissed

NamesNeverReplace == DistinctNames(calls)

OneInFlight ==
    /\ Cardinality(active) <= 1
    /\ guard = (active # {})
    /\ guard = (phase \in Busy)
    /\ phase = "starting" => active = {0}
    /\ phase \in Busy \ {"starting"} => active = {last}

FailureExit ==
    /\ phase = "error" =>
        (ended \in Causes /\ error = ended /\ ~guard /\ active = {})
    /\ ended \in Causes /\ phase # "starting" => phase = "error"
    /\ phase = "polling" => streak < FailureLimit
    /\ phase = "error" /\ ended = "poll" => streak = FailureLimit

TypeOK ==
    /\ mount \in 1..MountLimit
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ remote \in Seq({"running", "succeeded", "expired", "failed"})
    /\ Len(remote) <= TaskLimit
    /\ active \subseteq 0..TaskLimit
    /\ guard \in BOOLEAN
    /\ last \in 0..Len(remote)
    /\ name \in Names \cup {""}
    /\ origin \in {"none", "fresh", "recovery"}
    /\ streak \in 0..FailureLimit
    /\ dismissed \in 0..Len(remote)
    /\ cleared \subseteq Tasks
    /\ calls \in Seq(CallType)
    /\ Len(calls) <= TaskLimit + MountLimit
    /\ recoveryPending \in BOOLEAN
    /\ recoveryDismissed \in 0..TaskLimit
    /\ error \in Causes \cup {"none"}
    /\ ended \in Causes \cup {"none", "success"}

FreshDelivery == phase = "done" /\ origin = "fresh"
ReloadDelivery == phase = "done" /\ origin = "recovery" /\ mount = 2
RestartAfterTaskFailure == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "task"
RestartAfterDownloadFailure == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "download"
RestartAfterDeliveryFailure == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "delivery"
RestartAfterFivePollFailures == phase = "starting" /\ ended = "poll"
ClearedWorkDelivered ==
    \E i \in 1..Len(calls) : calls[i].afterClear /\ calls[i].result = "ok"
ClearBlocksRecovery ==
    mount = 2 /\ dismissed # 0 /\ phase = "idle" /\ ~recoveryPending
RejectedThenDelivered ==
    /\ mount = 2
    /\ \E i, j \in 1..Len(calls) :
        i < j /\ calls[i].task = calls[j].task
        /\ calls[i].result = "rejected" /\ calls[j].result = "ok"

Init ==
    /\ mount = 1
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ remote = <<>>
    /\ active = {}
    /\ guard = FALSE
    /\ last = 0
    /\ name = ""
    /\ origin = "none"
    /\ streak = 0
    /\ dismissed = 0
    /\ cleared = {}
    /\ calls = <<>>
    /\ recoveryPending = TRUE
    /\ recoveryDismissed = 0
    /\ error = "none"
    /\ ended = "none"

\* An independently created sidecar task can be observed by mount recovery.
SidecarTask ==
    /\ Latest < TaskLimit /\ ServiceFree
    /\ remote' = Append(remote, "running")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

SidecarFinish ==
    /\ \E t \in 1..Latest, s \in {"succeeded", "failed"} :
        remote[t] = "running" /\ remote' = [remote EXCEPT ![t] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

AgeOut ==
    /\ \E t \in 1..Latest :
        remote[t] = "succeeded" /\ remote' = [remote EXCEPT ![t] = "expired"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

Start ==
    /\ ~guard /\ Latest < TaskLimit
    /\ phase' = "starting"
    /\ active' = {0}
    /\ guard' = TRUE
    /\ name' \in Names
    /\ origin' = "fresh"
    /\ streak' = 0
    /\ error' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, dismissed, cleared, calls,
        recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, ended>>

RefuseStart ==
    /\ guard
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Create ==
    /\ phase = "starting" /\ Latest < TaskLimit /\ ServiceFree
    /\ remote' = Append(remote, "running")
    /\ last' = Latest + 1
    /\ active' = {Latest + 1}
    /\ phase' = "polling"
    /\ ended' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, guard, name, origin, streak, dismissed, cleared,
        calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error>>

\* Health, engine-readiness and create failures share start's catch/finally.
StartFailure ==
    /\ phase = "starting"
    /\ phase' = "error" /\ error' = "start" /\ ended' = "start"
    /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, streak, dismissed,
        cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed>>

Recover ==
    /\ recoveryPending /\ ~guard /\ Recoverable /\ Latest # dismissed
    /\ recoveryPending' = FALSE
    /\ recoveryDismissed' = dismissed
    /\ last' = Latest
    /\ phase' = "polling" /\ active' = {Latest} /\ guard' = TRUE
    /\ name' = "recovered-statue.stl" /\ origin' = "recovery"
    /\ streak' = 0 /\ ended' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, dismissed, cleared, calls, error>>

SkipRecovery ==
    /\ recoveryPending
    /\ guard \/ ~Recoverable \/ Latest = dismissed
    /\ recoveryPending' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin,
        streak, dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryDismissed, error, ended>>

PollRunning ==
    /\ phase = "polling" /\ RemoteStatus(last) = "running"
    /\ streak' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

PollSucceeded ==
    /\ phase = "polling" /\ RemoteStatus(last) \in {"succeeded", "expired"}
    /\ streak' = 0 /\ phase' = "download"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

PollTaskFailed ==
    /\ phase = "polling" /\ RemoteStatus(last) = "failed"
    /\ streak' = 0 /\ phase' = "error"
    /\ error' = "task" /\ ended' = "task" /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, dismissed, cleared,
        calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed>>

PollException ==
    /\ phase = "polling"
    /\ streak' = streak + 1
    /\ IF streak' = FailureLimit
        THEN /\ phase' = "error" /\ error' = "poll" /\ ended' = "poll"
             /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {}
        ELSE UNCHANGED <<phase, error, ended, guard, active>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, dismissed, cleared,
        calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed>>

DownloadOK ==
    /\ phase = "download" /\ phase' = "ready"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
        dismissed, cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed,
        error, ended>>

DownloadFailed ==
    /\ phase = "download" /\ phase' = "error"
    /\ error' = "download" /\ ended' = "download"
    /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, streak, dismissed,
        cleared, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed>>

InvokeDelivery ==
    /\ phase = "ready"
    /\ Once(NewCall) /\ DistinctNames(NewCall) /\ ClearCallsOK(NewCall)
    /\ phase' = "delivering" /\ calls' = NewCall
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin, streak,
        dismissed, cleared, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error, ended>>

DeliveryOK ==
    /\ phase = "delivering"
    /\ Once(SuccessfulCall) /\ DistinctNames(SuccessfulCall)
    /\ phase' = "done" /\ calls' = SuccessfulCall
    /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {} /\ ended' = "success"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, streak, dismissed,
        cleared, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error>>

DeliveryFailed ==
    /\ phase = "delivering" /\ phase' = "error" /\ calls' = RejectedCall
    /\ error' = "delivery" /\ ended' = "delivery"
    /\ guard' = FALSE /\ active' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, remote, last, name, origin, streak, dismissed,
        cleared, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed>>

Clear ==
    /\ last # 0
    /\ dismissed' = last /\ cleared' = cleared \cup {last}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mount, phase, remote, active, guard, last, name, origin,
        streak, calls, recoveryPending, recoveryDismissed, error, ended>>

Reload ==
    /\ mount < MountLimit /\ mount' = mount + 1
    /\ phase' = "idle" /\ active' = {} /\ guard' = FALSE /\ last' = 0
    /\ name' = "" /\ origin' = "none" /\ streak' = 0
    /\ recoveryPending' = TRUE /\ recoveryDismissed' = 0
    /\ error' = "none" /\ ended' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<remote, dismissed, cleared, calls>>

\* A timer, network call or callback may remain unresolved; no outside-world
\* fairness is assumed. Terminal states may also wait for a user action.
Wait == UNCHANGED vars

    \/ Recover \/ SkipRecovery
